services.text: WP Care helps with WordPress setup, hosting and domain basics, updates, backups, diagnostics, small fixes, and ongoing website support.

pricing.text: Pricing depends on the website and the scope of support.

process.text: Describe the website and the requested result, receive a scope and estimate, then approve the work before implementation.

limits.text: Standard support excludes major development, redesign, malware removal and recovery after serious incidents. VPS, Docker, DNS and email servers need a separate plan. Repair of third-party plugin defects is not guaranteed. Custom requests are reviewed and estimated first.

contact.text: Send a request in this bot: the specialist replies to your email. You can also email wp-care@taldav.com directly. Sending a request does not start work automatically.
